analysis.original_request: 我正在为低轨空间平台上的太阳盲紫外臭氧与高空燃烧羽流探测器设计前端滤光膜。探测器需要尽可能透过 255–280 nm 的太阳盲紫外信号，同时尽可能抑制 300–700 nm 可见光背景和 700–1100 nm 近红外杂散光。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，设计一个不含金属层、仅使用常规可沉积无机介质材料的平面多层膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a front-end filter coating for a solar-blind UV ozone and high-altitude combustion plume detector on a low-orbit space platform. The detector needs to maximize transmission of the 255–280 nm solar-blind UV signal while suppressing the 300–700 nm visible background and 700–1100 nm near-infrared stray light. Design a planar multilayer film under unspecified material incidence on a fused silica substrate, containing no metal layers, using only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials, with a total layer count not exceeding 30 layers.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request fits planar layered media scope; no unsupported features like gratings or nonlinear optics.
design_variables: Material selection from conventional inorganic dielectrics
manufacturing_constraints: Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials
ambiguities: Specific dielectric material candidates not specified
method_research_questions: Identification of UV-transparent high-index and low-index dielectric materials suitable for 255 nm operation
Optimization strategy to achieve high UV transmission and broad visible/NIR blocking within 30 layers
